top_signals.title: Roknifard: Iran Strategic With Use of Allies’ Attacks
top_signals.summary: The US says it has intercepted several Iranian ballistic missiles on its military bases - breaking the brief pause in fighting in the Middle East. Meanwhile the US and Saudi forces launched attacks on Iran-backed militia targets in Iraq in response to the drones attacking Saudi's energy infrastructure. Julia Roknifard, Senior Lecturer, School of law and governance at Taylor's University Malaysia spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the reescalation in the region. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: AI Still Driving Earnings Strength in Europe, Morgan Stanley Says
top_signals.summary: Marina Zavolock, chief European equity strategist at Morgan Stanley, says she hasn't seen such a strong earnings season in Europe in years. "We're seeing more interest in European equities in part because of the strong earnings season," she tells Bloomberg Television.  (Source: Bloomberg)
